title: Uniform cube expectation as product integration
statement: For every integer $n\ge0$ and every function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, its integral against the product of $n$ uniform probability measures on $\{0,1\}$ equals its uniform cube expectation $2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}f(x)$.
replaced: For every $n\ge0$ and $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, integration against the product of $n$ uniform bit measures equals the uniform cube expectation $2^{-n}\sum_xf(x)$.
